_comment: Chip Explorer element -> die master composition (explorer.py). Applied after the automatic links (exact name, element variants, job record dirs, view-index tiles) and before the generic variant fold and the purpose-token fallback. role: 'primary' = the element IS this master on this die (its status is the master's status; an exact-name element of the same master is demoted to lineage); 'part' = the element is hardened inside the master (the master rolls up its parts' worst status); 'relay' = the element is the register hop the die instantiates as these relay masters (status shown, the relay masters stay out of the die's master totals); 'lineage' = predecessor / pre-split / superseded form of what the master carries (shown on the card, never counted). 'die' (regex) limits a rule to some dies. 'dieless' lists elements with no master on any exported die and why; explorer.py reconciles every element of /api/elements against placements + dieless and reports the rest as unaccounted.
